open KdVPlan in ∀ τ : ℝ, 0<τ → ∀ f : Coeff, Data 0 f → Smooth f →
 ∀ L : ℕ, Piecewise 0 ((L:ℝ)*τ) (interp τ f)
proof:
exact (open KdVPlan in by
  intro τ hτ f hf hfs L
  obtain ⟨heq,hcont⟩:=@yui_aux_0076 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 τ hτ f hf hfs
  refine ⟨hcont L,Finset.image (fun n : ℕ=>(n:ℝ)*τ) (Finset.range (L+1)),?_⟩
  intro l r hl hlr hr hp
  let n : ℕ:=gridIndex τ l
  have hflo : (n:ℝ)≤l/τ ∧ l/τ<(n:ℝ)+1 :=
    (Nat.floor_eq_iff (div_nonneg hl hτ.le)).mp rfl
  have hnl : (n:ℝ)*τ≤l:=(le_div_iff₀ hτ).mp hflo.1
  have hln : l<((n:ℝ)+1)*τ:=(div_lt_iff₀ hτ).mp hflo.2
  have hnL : n<L:=by
    have hh : (n:ℝ)<(L:ℝ):=by nlinarith
    exact_mod_cast hh
  have hrn : r≤((n:ℝ)+1)*τ:=by
    by_contra! hh
    have hmem : ((n:ℝ)+1)*τ∈Finset.image (fun n : ℕ=>(n:ℝ)*τ) (Finset.range (L+1)):=by
      apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
      refine ⟨n+1,Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega),?_⟩
      simp only [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one]
    exact hp _ hmem ⟨hln,hh⟩
  have hd:=(@yui_aux_0037 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2.2.2 τ f hf n |>.2
  have hs:=(@yui_aux_0044 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2 τ f hfs n |>.2
  have hreg:=(@yui_aux_0071 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2.2 τ hτ n _ hd hs
  have hsm:=(@yui_aux_0074 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2 _ hreg l r hlr
  apply (@yui_aux_0075 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2 _ _ _ _ hsm
  intro t ht
  exact heq n t ⟨hnl.trans ht.1,ht.2.trans hrn⟩)
